chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Lu begins singing at seven at the Pollard Land concerts
summary: Lu sang and shimmied at yard concerts in her neighborhood from age seven, and got cold feet on stage until a friend stood beside her.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I had just started going to school. I started singing when I was about seven years old. See, around here we always played concerts. And one day we were playing a concert back at Pollard Land, they called this section, you know...
They called it a long time Pollard Land. This man named Pollard who owned all this land at one time, so they called it Pollard Land.

So we were playing concert, and the girls across the street heard me sing. See, they were going to have a concert. So they said, 'We're going to have a concert, and we want you to come and sing in our concert.' I said, 'All right.' So they came and asked my mother could I sing in the concert. So I was seven years old. So I was singing 'Sweet Papa's Seen(?) Marie' in the concert and doing the shimmy. And from then on, I would go... You know, they had the yard concerts that they was doing; I'd sing in the concerts... You know, pretty (?) around here.

So one time we went to sing a little further(?)... Miss Fanella gave a concert. And that was out of Pollard's Land then, you know. And when I got out on the stage and I saw all these strange people, I got kind of cold feet. So a girl named Woods, she said, "Well, if I go stand on the stage with you, would you sing?" I said, "Yes." So she just stood up there whilst I sang my song, you know. And the next time they had a concert, well, I wasn't ashamed.
